notes: Distributions are conditional on the player taking part; P(plays) is separate. Injury adjustments (Out 1%, game-time decision x0.65) are assumptions, not validated. Minutes do not react to teammates ruled out (lineup-aware minutes are off in live editions, D-037). No bookmaker prices were used.
Injury reports: SportsDataverse's daily snapshot of 5 Nov 2026 (published 20:32 UTC on 5 Nov). Injury news after that snapshot is not included.
Pts + Reb, Pts + Ast and Reb + Ast are built like PRA, from the same points, rebounds and assists forecasts. We hold no past bookmaker lines for them, so they have never been tested against prices.
